# 🛍️ AI E-commerce Product Description & SEO Optimizer MVP

## 📋 Commercial Job Offer Reference
- **Source Platform:** Malt (Freelance E-Commerce / Growth Marketing Agency Offer)
- **Job Title:** AI & Copywriting WebApp Engineer - E-commerce Multi-Platform Copy Generator
- **Client Industry:** E-commerce / D2C Brands / Growth Marketing
- **Estimated Budget / TJM:** 600€ / day (Estimated Project Duration: 5-6 days ~ 3,200€ MVP Package)

## 🎯 Application Overview
An intelligent e-commerce content generator designed for Shopify merchants, Amazon sellers, and marketing teams. Transforms raw product bullet points into SEO-optimized product titles, persuasive descriptions, features bullet points, and Google search meta descriptions.

## ⚡ Bolt Performance Optimizations
- **Instant Keyword Density Engine:** Real-time client-side keyword extraction running under 5ms without external network latency.
- **Tone Matrix Pre-compilation:** Pre-compiled template matrices for Instant, Professional, Minimalist, and High-Energy sales tones.
- **Client Storage Caching:** Generated copy variants are cached per product signature to prevent redundant token generations.
